name: parkin RBR E3 ubiquitin protein ligase
pathways: positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction

function.text: PRKN encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase parkin. Annotated molecular activities include transcription corepressor activity and ubiquitin-protein transferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of glucokinase activity and positive regulation of canonical NF-kappaB signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Parkinson disease (autosomal recessive); autosomal recessive juvenile Parkinson disease 2 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
